Then use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / 2a. Calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac) first - this tells you about the solutions. If it's positive, you get two real solutions. If zero, one real solution. If negative, two complex solutions. Plug everything into the formula and simplify.

First, find the derivative f'(x) - this gives you the slope at any point. Set f'(x) = 0 and solve for x - these are your stationary points. Then use the second derivative f''(x) to classify them.
